findings.title: Resume cannot recover an H5 renamed before its completion receipt
findings.observed_code: Assembly fsyncs .h5.pending, renames it to the final H5, then hashes the final multi-gigabyte file while constructing its identity sidecar. On resume, any existing final H5 triggers an unconditional sidecar read.
findings.failing_path: The existing Budget.run timeout or a process interruption after os.replace(tmp,dest) but before atomic_json(sidecar, ...) leaves dest present and sidecar absent. Every subsequent extraction resume raises FileNotFoundError at line 22 and never reaches FEATURES_COMPLETE. The RC-train payload is 645860*2048*4 = 5290885120 bytes, so hashing after rename is substantial work, not a millisecond filesystem race.
findings.impact: A normal supported interrupted extraction cannot finish from its already committed per-video pickles without manual artifact repair. No wrong numerical output is claimed; this is a real recovery failure in the newly added assembly path.
findings.smallest_bounded_repair: Reuse an existing H5 only when its completion sidecar exists and validates. If the sidecar is absent, treat the population assembly as uncommitted and replay it into .h5.pending from the committed validated pickles, then replace/commit as usual. Make the missing-H5 capacity estimate use the same committed criterion so replayed assembly is reserved. Preserve completed pickle/JPEG files and scientific parameters. A narrow server-only interface fixture for this interrupted state is sufficient; do not rerun whole-data or prior checks.
